data.name: Nejib
data.gender_notes: Nejib is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'n-j-b' meaning 'to give' or 'gift'. Nejib is the name of a person who is generous and kind. The name Nejib carries the meaning “Gifted, Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Nejib usually hope their child will grow to embody gifted, generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Nejib is a name that embodies the spiritual qualities of generosity and kindness. It is a reminder to be giving in all aspects of life, whether it is through time, resources or simply a kind word.
data.etymology: Nejib belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gifted, Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nejib total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
